title: Viola bound for low-degree polynomial signs
statement: Let $\phi$ be a probability density on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ that is $\varepsilon$-biased, where $0\leq\varepsilon\leq1$. For every integer $d\geq1$, the $d$-fold convolution power of $\phi$ fools every sign-valued function represented by a polynomial over $\mathbb{F}_2$ of algebraic degree at most $d$, with error at most $9\varepsilon^{1/2^{d-1}}$.
